card.name: Just before "at least" in spacing rules
card.fires_on: The last word before "at least" in dosing-interval instructions, such as "doses are", "antacids" or "inhibitors". It expects a minimum time gap or weight to follow.

modes.label: Gap between doses
modes.description: Word ending a clause about two doses, just before a minimum number of days apart.
modes.example: as long as these two doses<< are>> administered at least 14 days apart

modes.label: Drug to separate from another
modes.description: Name of a drug or drug class that must be given a set time before or after another drug.
modes.example: Administer magnesium or aluminum hydroxide containing antac<<ids>> at least 2h after CELLCEPT

modes.label: Minimum weight
modes.description: Word before a minimum body-weight group in dosage headings.
modes.example: Recommended Dosage in Adults and Pediatric Patients Weigh<<ing>> at Least 25 kg

card.writes: It promotes "at least" and its equivalents in several languages, so the model writes a minimum amount or time next.
card.plain: It fires on the word right before "at least" in instructions about spacing doses or minimum weight.
